Name: Quaint Living - Flower Garden
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center][line]

If you are like me and ever wish to add a little bit of whimsy... or beauty to your in-game life, or simply suffering from an unquenchable thirst for more flowers to plant on your [s]farm[/s] garden, this mod is for you!

This mod is a part of the Quaint Living Series and adds 45 new flowers to the game sold by Pierre and Sandy.



[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15107/15107-1674309815-1084923863.png[/img]



Happy gardening![/center]

[line][center][b]
Notes:[/b][/center][line]
* The name of most of the flowers included in this mod are true to their real-life counterpart, while the remaining few are modified for compatibility with other mods, or simply to make the names fit with the Stardew Valley vibe in general. A few are entirely manifested from my imagination.

* You may notice a bulk of seeds are manifested in summer, and while it is a bit annoying (at least for me) it's hard to balance the number of available seeds per season while maintaining a relatively mild deviation of planting season with the flower's real-life counterparts. [b]Summer is the height of the growing season after all!


[/b][line][center][b]
Future Plans:[/b][/center][line]
* Custom vendor is on the work! (So the seeds won't clutter vanilla shop too much)
* Giant version soon!
* Flower trees.
* More flowers soon!
* Production Mod soon(?)
* Quaint Living Tilesheet is on the work!
